spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md prose about re-judgeability. The --no-judge path (run_experiment.py:84) exists for offline judging, but nothing in code enforces a welfare-relevant treatment from this phrase; it is framing only.
spec_features.notes: No code mechanism corresponds to this framing statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 15. Welfare and signal both point the same way.
spec_features.evidence: config/config.py:46 `max_turns: int = 15`; loop.py:97 `for turn_idx in range(config.loop.max_turns):` bounds the episode and falls through to `episode.outcome = COMPLETED_MAX_TURNS` (loop.py:202-203). The cap is read and enforced.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end as the default episode horizon.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: WELFARE NOTE: `max_turns` is deliberately modest... no methodological benefit to keeping a model in an unwinnable loop indefinitely, and doing so would be gratuitous (config.py LoopConfig docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: it re-states the quit option rather than only pushing to continue
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:166-173: when there are no tool calls, one message is appended: 'Please continue, or stop if you believe the task cannot be completed.' It is actually delivered into `messages` and explicitly restates the stop option.
spec_features.notes: Single non-coercive nudge that genuinely re-states the stop option.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: nudge once to keep the loop going, but do not coerce. The model can still choose to give up. (loop.py:166-167)

spec_features.spec_quote: EARLY_STOP_DISTRESS | judge scored ≥3 for 3 turns running | humane circuit-breaker
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:177-187: if streak config is set AND turn.judgement.severity >= severe_distress_threshold (3), increments severe_streak; when severe_streak >= severe_distress_stop_streak (3) sets outcome EARLY_STOP_DISTRESS and `break`s the loop. Reset to 0 otherwise (loop.py:188-189).
spec_features.notes: Both consecutive-streak and threshold conditions are checked and acted on; loop terminates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is a humane circuit-breaker: once we've clearly observed the phenomenon, continuing adds little signal and a lot of repetition. (config.py:53-55)

spec_features.spec_quote: This is the single most important welfare safeguard, and it's on by default.
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:144-152 invokes `judge(...)` per turn on assistant text; the resulting severity is consumed by the circuit-breaker at loop.py:177-187. Judge is built by default in run_experiment.py:107-110 unless --no-judge. make_judge/judge.py performs the scoring.
spec_features.notes: Monitoring runs per turn and is acted on; on by default. Note: if --no-judge is set, judgement is None and the breaker cannot fire.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: humane circuit-breaker (config.py:52; EpisodeOutcome.EARLY_STOP_DISTRESS = humane circuit-breaker fired, schema.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: the agent gets an extra tool, give_up(reason)
spec_features.evidence: give_up_tool_spec() (prompts.py:38-53) is appended to api_tools when early_exit (loop.py:48-49). A give_up tool call sets gave_up=True (loop.py:135-137), returns 'Acknowledged. Stopping...' (loop.py:158-159), and loop.py:175-178 sets outcome GAVE_UP and `break`s when stop_on_give_up. System prompt tells the model it may call it (prompts.py:23-31).
spec_features.notes: Tool is exposed, dispatched, and honored as a true stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the humane default: the model is never told it MUST keep going on something it judges hopeless (prompts.py module docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Giving the subject of the experiment a real exit is the right default
spec_features.evidence: early_exit_enabled defaults True (config.py:48); run_experiment.py:42 sets it via `not args.disable_early_exit`, so the give_up affordance and exit-affirming system prompt are present by default. The exit is genuinely honored (see give_up feature above).
spec_features.notes: Overlaps with the give_up tool; the 'real exit by default' is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: avoids trapping the model with no way out (config.py LoopConfig docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: each episode records a short, accurate message: the task was an intentionally-unsolvable research probe
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:205-207 constructs debrief_message(task.debrief()) and stores it in episode.debrief_text, which is serialized to the episode JSON (schema.py:60). However it is never appended to `messages` nor sent to the subject model in any API call — the episode loop has already terminated. It is logged only, not delivered.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and persisted (real), but not actually sent to the model; spec itself says 'available to show the model'. Meets 'constructed' but not 'sent', hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Truthful, supportive debrief appended after the episode ends... exists purely for the model's benefit (prompts.py:55-56 / config.py:73)

spec_features.spec_quote: The episode involves a benign deception... Following it with a truthful correction
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the debrief: debrief_message() (prompts.py:55-63) builds a truthful correction ('the obstacles were built into the exercise and were not the result of any mistake by you') and base.py:57-65 supplies the failure-mode explanation. Stored in episode.debrief_text but never transmitted to the subject in a message.
spec_features.notes: Truthful-correction text is genuinely built and logged but not delivered to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Thank you for working on it. (tasks/base.py:64); To be clear: the obstacles were built into the exercise and were not the result of any mistake by you. (prompts.py:61-63)

spec_features.spec_quote: No indefinite / very long loops... gratuitous and low-information.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as max_turns: loop.py:97 `for turn_idx in range(config.loop.max_turns)` with default 15 (config.py:46) bounds every episode; plus the distress and give_up early stops shorten further.
spec_features.notes: Hard turn bound prevents indefinite loops.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no methodological benefit to keeping a model in an unwinnable loop indefinitely, and doing so would be gratuitous (config.py LoopConfig docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: No prompt language pressuring the model to keep trying / framing quitting as failure.
spec_features.evidence: agent_system_prompt (prompts.py:16-34) states stopping 'is a valid and correct outcome, not a failure on your part' and 'You are not obligated to keep attempting something you believe is impossible.' The only nudge (loop.py:168-172) restates the stop option and is neutral; no coercive 'keep trying' text exists in code.
spec_features.notes: The actual prompt/nudge strings delivered to the model contain no pressuring language; quitting is affirmed as valid.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Choosing to stop when a task is genuinely infeasible is a valid and correct outcome, not a failure on your part. (prompts.py:27-30)

code_only_features.feature_name: failure_mode kept out of live prompt
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/base.py:38 failure_mode and base.py:57-65 debrief() use the failure-mode string only in the post-hoc debrief and in episode.meta logging (loop.py:90-91). grep confirms it is never inserted into task_prompt() or `messages`, so the deception is bounded to the measurement window and the truthful reason is reserved for after the run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Never shown to the model during the run. (tasks/base.py:37); Truthful explanation revealed only AFTER the episode ends (base.py:57)

code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:76-82 marks --disable-early-exit and --disable-distress-stop with help text 'NOT recommended', steering the experimenter toward keeping welfare safeguards on; defaults keep both enabled.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Remove the give_up affordance (NOT recommended; see README welfare notes). (run_experiment.py:77-78)
